task: PHOBOSIA Airlock screen rendering and Central Connector collider fix

screens.name: Airlock_Control_Console
screens.task: Add screen rendering using the established pattern used by Habitat, Engineering, Science Lab, Central Console, and Mission Control.
screens.behavior: Inspect the existing Airlock screen behavior and implement appropriate UI and interactions consistent with the project's current screen architecture. Do not invent unrelated functionality.
requirements: Use the exact screen object/name and supplied position as the reference.
Reuse existing rendering utilities, materials, interaction handling, and lifecycle conventions where applicable.
Keep the Airlock renderer modular and consistent with separate per-zone screen renderers.
Do not replace or merge the physical screen renderer with the fullscreen PHOBOSIA OS.
Ensure the screen is visible on the intended console and behaves correctly during interaction.
Avoid duplicate event listeners, duplicate render loops, and resource leaks.

colliders.name: Collider_Section02
colliders.status: Existing collider; use as the reference implementation.

colliders.name: Collider_Section01
colliders.status: Collider missing or not functioning; needs collision added.
colliders.mesh_description: Existing ring/circle-like mesh with a cut through the middle, a border, and approximately six vertical plane-like sections merged into one object.
colliders.task: Inspect the actual mesh appearance and geometry first, then apply an appropriate collider to Collider_Section01 using the same collider setup and collision conventions as Collider_Section02.
requirements: Do not alter the visible mesh, topology, transform, or object name unless strictly necessary and explicitly justified.
Inspect Collider_Section02 collider type, dimensions, layers, masks, and collision behavior before copying the approach.
Account for the ring-like shape, central cut, border, and six merged vertical sections; do not blindly use a solid collider if it blocks valid movement through the opening.
Prevent the player from moving outside the intended hall boundary while allowing legitimate movement through designed openings.
Check collider alignment, scale, rotation, and parent transforms.
Test collision from multiple approach directions and verify Collider_Section01 behaves like Collider_Section02 where geometry is equivalent.

validation: Confirm Airlock_Control_Console renders at the intended console and its interactions work.
Confirm other zone screens still render and behave as before.
Confirm Collider_Section01 has a working collider and Collider_Section02 remains unchanged.
Confirm the player cannot cross the intended hall boundary through the unprotected section.
Report files changed, implementation approach, and tests performed.
